lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No cast-shadow field or coherent sun direction is visible, but basalt top planes remain consistently lighter than exposed vertical faces. The aggregate orientation metric does not override this literal equal-value failure.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: The broad inland grass and level slab shelf counts as buildable; sea-stack faces and exposed ledge faces count as steep; the shingle cove, broken shore slabs, boulders, and vegetation make up the remainder.

crown.method: Complete visual census at native source resolution found no conifers or tree crowns; the Sound-coast cell is intentionally treeless.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.method: South-and-west-connected teal and turquoise evidence was traced through the complete sea, shallows, wash, surf, reflections, and submerged-slab water; the wet fringe was included, enclosed interruptions were filled, and the binary hole-free result was checked against a full-canvas overlay.

refusalReasons: The highest-priority lighting rule still fails visually: broad basalt top planes are consistently lighter than vertical faces.
The estimated buildable fraction is about 0.56 of non-water land rather than the territory target of roughly one third.
openRisks: Two whole-canvas candidates reproduced the same top-plane-versus-face value hierarchy, so the two-strikes rule blocks a third generation using the same prompting approach.
The low central offshore outcrop is below the specified 12-20 m stack class and is not counted among the four qualifying stacks, but a reviewer may read it as a fifth small stack.
The water mask passes dimension, binary-alpha, connectivity, edge, and no-hole checks and was visually inspected as an overlay; exact coastline judgment remains a human visual gate.
No artifact was promoted outside quarantine.
recommendedReframe: Use a generation path with an explicit flat albedo or unlit-material control, or author the terrain in a renderer whose material values are deterministic; prompt-only ImageGen has now failed the literal equal-value rock-face rule twice.
